dm.title: 🏢 office.plan(week={week}) // {range}
dm.question:
Which days will your physical instance be in the office {when}?
Select all elements that return true:
dm.status.empty: ⏳ No answer saved yet (null). Empty selection + Commit = no office day.
dm.hint: Changes are mutable until {deadline}. They are only persisted once you click *git commit*.
dm.closed.no_answer: Request timed out – you did not respond.
dm.superseded: ↪️ This message is deprecated and has been replaced. Please use the latest message below (HEAD).
dm.away: 🌴 Status set to away (AFK) for this week. Reminders are piped to /dev/null, and the summary lists you as away.
dm.away.hint: Back online after all? Until {deadline} you can roll back the absence and pick your days.
dm.away.answered: Answer already committed and this week's sprint is running – no force-push over history. Use 🌴 Schedule downtime to log your downtime from today on.
reminder.text: ⏰ PING: Please tell us which days you will be in the office in week {week} – deadline {deadline}. Don't panic, it only takes a moment.
summary.title: 🏢 Office attendance – week {week} // {range}
summary.project: ⭐ Bot passes all your tests? <{url}|git star it on GitHub>
timeoff.title: Scheduled downtime
timeoff.intro: During downtime you get no poll and no reminders. If you are offline for a whole week, the channel summary lists you as away.
timeoff.error.missing: 400 Bad Request: please choose a date.
timeoff.error.order: Invalid range: the last day must not be before the first day.
timeoff.error.past: Time travel not supported: the first day must not be in the past.
timeoff.error.too_far: Out of bounds: downtime can be scheduled at most one year ahead.
timeoff.error.failed: 500 Internal Server Error. Please retry in a moment.
language.name: Nerd (English)
language.title: setlocale()
language.intro: Set your locale: which language should I use for your poll, reminders and replies? The channel summary stays on the team default (shared state).
language.label: LANG
reply.try_again: Segmentation fault. Please try again in a moment.
reply.save_unavailable: 503 Service Unavailable: saving is not possible right now. Please retry in a moment.
reply.save_failed: Commit failed – your selection could not be saved. Please try again.
reply.unreadable: Parse error – your selection could not be read. Please try again.
reply.poll_gone: 410 Gone: this poll no longer exists.
reply.not_participant: 403 Forbidden: you are not registered for this poll.
reply.stale_dm: Stale cache detected. Please use the current poll message.
reply.stale_summary: Stale cache detected. Please use this week's current overview.
reply.closed: 🔒 The poll has been read-only since {deadline}.
reply.closed_no_changes: 🔒 The poll has been read-only since {deadline}. No more commits accepted.
reply.dm_pending: 📩 Your poll is already in the queue and should appear in your direct messages shortly.
reply.dm_cooldown: 📩 429 Too Many Requests – I just sent you the poll. Please check your direct messages.
reply.dm_resent: 📩 Retransmitting the poll by direct message. Your previous selection is kept.
reply.not_eligible: Access denied: you are not in the group for this poll. If you have questions, contact the sysadmin who runs the bot.
reply.late_joiner_added: 📩 Hot-plugged: you have been added to this week's poll. I will send it to you by direct message shortly.
change.no_office: 🔄 *{name}* reverted all office days this week (remote only).
change.back: 🔄 *{name}* is back online in the office: `+{added}`
